text:
jia: quick stand 1791239999 179 0 proposing we lock scope for the isolation sprint: routing clampdowns, tenant pinning, and failover hygiene.

omar: agree. want clear failure definitions: noisy-tenant cascade, sudden capacity exhaustion, and region egress surge.

victor: data-residency tenants need an explicit 'no-cross-region' mode. also call out private deployments where audit is the gating factor.

sam: draft acceptance checks: observability (per-tenant p50/p95/p99), routing policy (pin, soft-affinity, overflow), evacuation runbook, compliance flag. add SLO gates for rollout.

jia: sketch SLO gates: during canary p99 <= 2x baseline and error-rate delta < 0.5%. cost guard: block auto-failover if estimated burst >3x baseline unless tenant opts in.

omar: canary plan: 6 tenants (mix synthetic + low-impact real) across 3 regions, staged -> 6 -> 30. rollback triggers: p99>baseline*2 or error-rate >0.7% for 5m.
victor: KV-warmup metric: >=95% requests served from primed KV within 5m post-failover. add audit events for pin/unpin and evacuation.
sam: Console UX ask: "pin preview" showing eviction risk and cost delta. mark Q2 P2.

console-bot: note: canary job queued. auto-rollback policy is enabled.

jia: decisions: residency eviction manual-only, default cost-cap 3x, canary composition approved. I'll update RFC and playbook tonight.
omar: i'll produce chaos scripts.
victor: i'll draft compliance checklist and audit schema.
sam: will open Console ticket for pin preview.

jia: aim to review RFC by Friday and schedule canary sprint+1. thanks :thumbsup:
